root_cause.text: The `sev_pin_memory()` function in the KVM SEV subsystem uses a `WARN_ON_ONCE` assertion to validate the user-controlled page count (`npages`), allowing userspace to trivially trigger a kernel warning by passing an extremely large size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes `WARN_ON_ONCE(npages > INT_MAX)` and replaces it with a standard error check (`if (npages > INT_MAX) return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);`), while the commit message notes that the warning is "comically trivially to trigger from userspace" by passing a size of `-1ul` to `KVM_MEMORY_ENCRYPT_REG_REGION`.
